1 Welcome to Prime Talker

Welcome to Prime Talker — a communication platform that helps people connect across different languages. You can join voice and video meetings, communicate through chat, and use real-time speech translation to make conversations easier.

What can you do with Prime Talker?

🎙️

Voice Calls

Communicate using your microphone.

📹

Video Meetings

See and speak with the other participant.

🌍

Language Selection

Choose your language for the meeting.

⚡

Real-Time Translation

Follow conversations across language barriers.

💬

Meeting Chat

Exchange text messages during a meeting.

🖥️

Screen Sharing

Share your screen with the other participant.

Where should you begin?

  1. New to Prime Talker? Create an account and verify your email address.
  2. Already have an account? Sign in to access the Rooms page.
  3. Ready to meet? Create a meeting room or open a meeting link shared with you.
💡 Tip: Follow the sections in this guide in order if you are using Prime Talker for the first time.

2 Creating an Account

New to Prime Talker? Create an account to get started. Once you verify your email address, you will be automatically redirected to the Prime Talker landing page.

Follow these steps

  1. Open the sign-up page. From the Prime Talker landing page, select the option to get started or sign in, then choose the sign-up option.
  2. Enter your details. Fill in the requested information, including your username, email address, country, and state or region.
  3. Create a password. Enter a password that meets the requirements shown on the sign-up form and confirm it if requested.
  4. Submit your registration. Review your details and click the sign-up button.
  5. Verify your email address. Open the verification email and click the verification link to confirm your account.
  6. You're ready to get started! After successful verification, Prime Talker will automatically redirect you to the landing page. You do not need to sign in again at this stage.
💡 Helpful tips
  • Use an email address you can access.
  • Create a strong, unique password.
  • If the verification email is missing, check your spam folder.
  • Keep your password private.
Already have an account? If you are returning to Prime Talker, simply sign in using your registered email address and password. You do not need to create another account.

3 Signing In

Already have a Prime Talker account? Sign in with your registered email address and password to access your account.

Follow these steps

  1. Open Prime Talker. Visit the Prime Talker website and select the option to sign in.
  2. Enter your registered email. Use the email address associated with your Prime Talker account.
  3. Enter your password. Type the password you created when registering.
  4. Sign in to your account. Select the sign-in button to continue.
  5. Start using Prime Talker. Once sign-in is successful, you can access the available features and navigate to the Rooms page to create or join a meeting.
💡 Helpful tips
  • Make sure you use the email address you registered with.
  • Check that your password is entered correctly.
  • If you have forgotten your password, use the password recovery option if it is available on the sign-in page.
  • New users should complete email verification before signing in.
First time or returning user? After creating an account and verifying your email, you are automatically redirected to the landing page. When you return to Prime Talker later, sign in with your registered credentials.

4 Creating a Room

Create a meeting room when you want to start a conversation with another person. Prime Talker supports voice and video meetings with language and voice options.

Follow these steps

  1. Sign in to Prime Talker. Open the website and sign in with your registered credentials.
  2. Open the Rooms page. Navigate to Rooms to access the meeting options.
  3. Create a room. Select the option to create a new meeting room.
  4. Choose your language and voice. Select the required language and voice options before starting the meeting.
  5. Start the meeting. Follow the on-screen instructions to enter your meeting room.
  6. Invite another participant. Copy and share the meeting link with the person you want to speak with.
  7. Wait for the other participant. Once they join, you can begin your conversation.
💡 Helpful tips
  • A meeting room supports a maximum of two participants: the room creator and one guest.
  • Share the meeting link only with the intended participant.
  • Make sure your microphone and camera permissions are enabled for the features you want to use.
  • Choose the language you want to use so translated conversations can work as expected.
Good to know If the room already has two participants, another person cannot join until the room becomes available. When the room creator ends the meeting, the room is closed.

5 Joining a Room

You can join a Prime Talker meeting in two ways: by opening a meeting link shared by the room creator or by entering a Room ID on the Rooms page.

Option 1: Join using a meeting link

This option is useful when someone shares a meeting link directly with you. You do not need a Prime Talker account to join through the link.

  1. Open the meeting link. Click the link shared by the room creator to open the meeting's joining page.
  2. Enter your name. Type the name you want other participants to see.
  3. Select your language and voice. Choose your preferred language and an available voice option.
  4. Join the meeting. Click the Join Meeting button to enter the room.
  5. Allow device permissions. Allow microphone or camera access in your browser for the features you want to use.

Option 2: Join using a Room ID

If you have a Room ID instead of a meeting link, you must have a Prime Talker account and sign in to access the Rooms page.

  1. Sign in to Prime Talker. Use your registered email address and password.
  2. Open the Rooms page. Navigate to Rooms after signing in.
  3. Enter the Room ID. Type the Room ID provided by the person who created the meeting into the Room ID field.
  4. Join the room. Select the required language and voice options and follow the on-screen instructions to enter the meeting.
💡 Helpful tips
  • Use the meeting link if you do not have a Prime Talker account.
  • If you are joining with a Room ID, sign in first and enter the ID on the Rooms page.
  • Double-check the Room ID before joining.
  • Choose the correct language and voice.
Room capacity A meeting supports a maximum of two participants: the room creator and one guest. If both places are occupied, another participant cannot join that room.

6 In the Meeting

Once both participants are connected, you can use Prime Talker's meeting features to communicate, manage your devices, share information, and control your meeting.

🎙️ Audio & Voice Translation

  • 🗣️ Speak in your selected language Talk naturally using the language you selected for your meeting.
  • 🌐 Real-time speech translation Communicate across languages with translated speech during the conversation.
  • 🎤 Mute or unmute your microphone Control when your microphone is active during the meeting.

📹 Video & Camera Controls

  • 📷 Turn your camera on or off Manage whether your video is visible to the other participant.
  • 👥 View the other participant See the other participant's video when their camera is enabled.

💬 Meeting Chat

  • ✉️ Send chat messages Exchange written messages with the other participant during the meeting.
  • 📝 Share information in writing Use chat when you need to communicate details without speaking.

🖥️ Screen Sharing

  • 📺 Share your screen Present content from your screen to the other participant.
  • 🪟 Select what to share Follow your browser's prompts to choose the screen or window you want to present.
  • ⏹️ Stop sharing when finished End your screen-sharing session when your presentation is complete.

⏱️ Meeting Duration & Ending the Call

  • 🕒 Check the meeting duration View the meeting timer to keep track of how long your conversation has lasted.
  • 📴 End the meeting Use the end-call control when you are ready to finish the meeting.
  • 📋 View the meeting summary After the meeting ends, view details such as participant names, languages, and duration.
💡 Tips for a better meeting experience
  • Use a stable internet connection.
  • Speak clearly and reduce background noise.
  • Check your browser's microphone and camera permissions if a device does not work.
  • Use screen sharing when you need to show information visually.
ℹ️ Important to know A meeting supports a maximum of two participants: the room creator and one guest. If the guest leaves, the creator can remain in the room. When the creator ends the meeting, the room is closed.

7 Managing Your Profile

Your Prime Talker profile lets you manage your personal information, profile picture, and account password. Keep your details up to date for a better experience.

👤 Update your profile information

  • 📝 Open your profile Navigate to the Profile page from the Prime Talker website.
  • ✏️ Edit your details Update the profile fields available to you, such as your name, username, phone number, or bio.
  • 💾 Save your changes Select Save to apply your updates. Check that the saved information remains after refreshing the page.

🖼️ Manage your profile picture

  • 📷 Add or change your picture Upload an image using the profile picture controls on the Profile page.
  • 🗑️ Remove your picture Use the remove-picture option if you want to clear your current profile image.

🔐 Change your password

  1. Open the Profile page. Navigate to the Security & Login area.
  2. Open the password section. Select the option to change your password.
  3. Enter your current password. Provide your existing password for verification.
  4. Enter and confirm your new password. Use a strong password that meets the displayed requirements and enter it again for confirmation.
  5. Save your new password. Follow the on-screen confirmation before using your new password the next time you sign in.
💡 Helpful tips
  • Remember to save your profile changes before leaving the page.
  • Choose a strong, unique password.
Keep your account secure Only update your own account information. If you change your password, use the new password for future sign-ins.

8 Contact Us — Getting Help

If you experience any issues while using Prime Talker, you can contact our team through the Contact Us page. Follow the steps below to explain your issue and request help.

📩 How to contact the Prime Talker team

  1. Open the Contact Us page. Navigate to the Contact Us page from the Prime Talker website using the Contact Us option.
  2. Enter your details. Fill in the information requested on the Contact Us page, including your name and phone number.. etc,all the fields that are displayed.
  3. Subject. Give a short note about the issue you are facing.
  4. Message. Explain the issue you are experiencing in detail. Include any relevant information that can help the team understand and resolve your problem.
  5. Send Message. Click the Send Message button to submit your request for assistance. You will receive a confirmation that your message has been sent.
  6. Check your email for a response. Monitor the email address you provided so you can respond if the team needs additional information.

🛠️ What issues can you report?

  • Account creation, sign-in, or email verification issues.
  • Problems creating or joining a meeting room.
  • Microphone, camera, or screen-sharing issues.
  • Speech translation or language-selection problems.
  • Other technical difficulties or questions about Prime Talker.
💡 Helpful tip Provide as much relevant information as possible so the team can understand the issue. Never include your password or other sensitive account information in your message.
ℹ️ Important to know Make sure you provide a valid email address that you can access. Response times may vary. If the issue continues, provide any additional details when following up with the team.
